method: Fresh production game; normal keyboard and ground-click movement into the first encounter, then Attack and incoming guard. No game fixtures or clock changes.
checks: Incoming enemy attack opens the same visible track as Attack; actual Enter press catches the live orange window.
Enemy recovery restores Crew and the original selected companion.
Pause/resume retains incoming timing; mouse click also catches the live window.
An unattempted incoming attack also restores the previous slot after recovery.
